title: Cruise Ship Mall World
content: I often have Mallworld dreams, and lately they've been recurring on a cruise ship. All or partially, it varies. My cabin on board is usually gross with lots of broken things, smelling of mold and lit with greenish white industrial lighting. The area around it is not hotel like as in a cruise ships guest quarters, but functional like crew cabins. There is also a very exclusive area where you have to go past an open deck with a huge pool (and few swimmers), and then it's a brightly lit and very colorful upscale mall with luxury shops and I always feel like I'm not supposed to be there. This is probably because I worked onboard cruise ships are one point in my life, but it was only 1 year way back in 2007-8. I also worked in a mall for a couple years before that, when I was in college. And as a 90s kid I grew up as a little mallrat, spending most of my socializing time there and always going with my family when I was very young. I think all of this makes sense from a Jungian archetypal POV. But when I see the other details in discussions here it does seem even more uncanny. I was also a so-called "gifted and talented" kid in the late 80s - early 90s and I think the program was still very new at that time. Interested to see feedback on the cruise ship thing.
